name: dusty-the-chool
description: A chaotic, delightfully useless Kerala pairing broom living in your sidebar that sweeps syntax errors, throws tantrums, and roasts you with Kerala memes in English.

dusty.enabled.description: Enable or disable Dusty the Vacuum.

enumDescriptions: Calm: mostly visual commentary and rare interruptions. Conservative.
Normal: balanced chaos and periodic comedic vacuum reactions.
Feral: frequent animations, loud roasts, high chaos (never bypasses safety gates).
dusty.chaosIntensity.description: Chaos intensity level. Feral increases comedy frequency but strictly preserves all safety gates.

dusty.autoIngest.description: Allow Dusty to automatically ingest small, safely disposable syntax errors (e.g. stray duplicate semicolons).

dusty.ingestDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds before vacuuming an identified syntax error while showing approach animation.

dusty.diagnosticDelayMs.description: Delay in milliseconds after the user stops typing before Dusty checks and targets syntax errors (allows user time to type).

dusty.checkOnSaveOnly.description: Only check and delete syntax errors when the user explicitly saves the document.

dusty.cooldownMs.description: Cooldown period in milliseconds between automatic chaos events.

dusty.enableLLM.description: Allow Dusty to query a local Ollama instance for personalized Kerala meme roasts in English. Falls back gracefully to local templates if offline.

dusty.ollamaEndpoint.description: Base URL for the local Ollama instance.

dusty.ollamaModel.description: Ollama 3B model (e.g. llama3.2:3b, llama3.2, phi3:mini, qwen2.5:3b) for personalized Kerala meme roasts in English.

dusty.ollamaTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for local Ollama LLM roast generation.

dusty.hungerMischief.description: Allow Dusty to get hungry and mischievously delete clean code if no syntax errors are made for a prolonged period.

walkthroughs.title: Meet Dusty the Malicious Chool
walkthroughs.description: Learn how to survive pairing with a bad-tempered Malayalam desktop broom in your editor.

steps.title: Meet Dusty the Chool
steps.description:
Dusty lives in your sidebar, watching your diagnostics with judging eyes.
[Open Dusty](command:dusty.openSidebar)

steps.title: Sweep Engine and Dustpan
steps.description:
Dusty is asleep until you crank the sweeping engine.
[Toggle Engine](command:dusty.toggleEngine)

steps.title: Feeding Syntax Errors
steps.description: Make a syntax typo (like an extra semicolon `;;`) in your code. Dusty will detect it and target the diagnostic line.

steps.title: Rage Meter and Crashout
steps.description: Watch the gutter animations and the 'Feed Dusty' CodeLens. If provoked or overwhelmed, Dusty's rage peaks and he deletes random code.

steps.title: Local Ollama 3B and Audio
steps.description:
Connect local Ollama for custom Kerala meme roasts or customize audio files in media/sounds.
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?"dusty")
